Location: San Ramon, CA
Description:

An entry-level Galley Utility/Messman position is available on a US Flag fleet vessel. The role operates within the Galley Department, reporting to the Steward and Chief Mate. The anticipated hourly rate is $22.31, with an assignment length of approximately 90 days for unlicensed personnel. Vacation accrues at 25 days for every 30 days worked. Required credentials include a USCG Merchant Mariner Document, TWIC, valid passport, USCG/STCW Medical Certificate, and VPDSD endorsement.
